mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 3.0% signals imminent Fed tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS decline >0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by >0.5% in the last month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in unemployment signals labor market strengthening, delaying Fed rate hikes and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE declines by >0.2pp in high unemployment regimes, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates economic strength, boosting corporate earnings and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO rises by >0.5% in the last month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST exceeding 1500 thousand units signals strong consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1500, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous PAYEMS increase and UNRATE decline indicate a robust labor market, supporting consumer spending and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases >0.5% and UNRATE declines >0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS increases by >0.5% and UNRATE declines by >0.2pp in the last month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO falling below 110 signals economic slowdown, reducing earnings expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO falls below 110, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
